name: LibreNMS Open-Source Network Monitoring
free_limit: Free GPL-3.0-or-later licensed network monitoring software with SNMP auto-discovery, device health and alerting on user-operated servers; no vendor-hosted free quota or software license charge.
watch_out: Requires self-managed PHP/database/web infrastructure, network and SNMP access, secure credentials, updates and backups. Hardware, storage, notifications and optional commercial support are separate; GPL license and bundled third-party notices apply.
